source_caption:
🎥🍿: Frankenhooker (1990)

A brilliant but socially awkward medical student, Jeffrey Franken, is devastated when his fiancée Elizabeth is killed in a tragic accident. Unable to accept losing the woman he loves, Jeffrey becomes obsessed with bringing her back to life using his knowledge of science and experimentation.

His twisted plan leads him into the world of illegal body parts and bizarre experiments as he attempts to recreate Elizabeth’s body. When his experiments take a dark turn, Jeffrey creates a new version of his fiancée that is far from what he imagined.

Blending outrageous horror, dark comedy, and a wild take on the Frankenstein story, Frankenhooker follows Jeffrey’s descent into madness as his dream of resurrection becomes a chaotic nightmare.

source_details.synopsis: Frankenhooker is a 1990 American comedy horror film co-written and directed by Frank Henenlotter. The film is an homage to and parody of Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein, and stars James Lorinz and former Penthouse Pet Patty Mullen. After his fiancée is decapitated by a lawnmower, medical school dropout Jeffrey Franken attempts to resurrect her by assembling the body parts of prostitutes, unwittingly creating a nymphomaniacal monster.
